products.name: The Gentle Beginning — Free Shadow Work Starter
products.description:
Begin here. This is free — and it's real.
Five shadow work prompts for the part of you that's ready to look, but doesn't want to be rushed. The Gentle Beginning is Midnight Magnolia's welcome to you — a short PDF designed to meet you exactly where you are, without demanding anything you're not ready to give.
What's inside:
5 carefully crafted shadow work prompts
A welcome letter from founder Latisha Vincent
Gentle framing for each prompt — no clinical language
Breathing cues between pages
Instant download, yours to keep. Download it free. Begin when you're ready.

products.name: Shadow Work Starter Kit
products.description:
Thirty days of turning inward. One prompt at a time.
The Shadow Work Starter Kit is a 30-prompt guided journal designed for neurodivergent women who are ready to do the quiet, honest work of healing — on their own terms, at their own pace. No clinical language. No performance. Just you and the page.
What's inside:
30 shadow work prompts organized in a 30-day arc
3 themed sections: The Foundation, The Pattern, The Return
Gentle framing for every prompt
Generous writing space on every page
A note on neurodivergence and non-linear use
Closing reflection + next steps
Begin your shadow work tonight. Instant download, 40–50 pages, beautifully designed.

products.name: Ancestral Healing Journal
products.description:
You cannot fully heal what you do not know the roots of.
The Ancestral Healing Journal bridges personal healing with lineage work. Rooted in the African diaspora, the American South, and the tradition of oral storytelling and family memory, this 40-prompt journal begins the excavation — gently, deliberately, with deep respect for what was passed down and what was lost.
What's inside:
40 prompts across 3 parts: What Was Passed Down, The Inheritance You Chose, and The Return
An opening letter on ancestral healing in plain language
A note on the Lowcountry and Southern Black experience
Space to write, sit, and return to
Designed specifically for the African diaspora experience
Instant download. 50–60 pages. There is no other healing journal like this one.

products.name: Creative Foundations Workbook
products.description:
Structure and creativity were never opposites. This workbook proves it.
The Creative Foundations Workbook is built for neurodivergent creators who need systems that actually work with their brain — not against it. It brings together project planning, creative rhythm-setting, and intentional work design in a format that is gentle, visual, and genuinely usable.
What's inside:
A framework for understanding your creative energy cycles
Project mapping tools designed for nonlinear thinkers
Gentle systems for managing multiple creative projects
Prompts for identifying your creative values and boundaries
A weekly rhythm template that works for executive function differences
Instant download. For the creator who is done apologizing for how their mind works.

products.name: Deep Roots Shadow Work System
products.description:
The complete system. The flagship. The one you've been building toward.
The Deep Roots Shadow Work System is a full curriculum for the woman who is done dipping in and ready to go deep. It combines shadow work, ancestral healing, identity reclamation, and creative rebuilding into a structured 30-week arc — with the flexibility to move at your own pace, in your own season.
What's inside:
A full shadow work curriculum across 5 modules
Module 1: The Excavation — understanding your shadow landscape
Module 2: The Inheritance — ancestral patterns and lineage healing
Module 3: The Reckoning — relationships, trauma, and the body
Module 4: The Reclamation — identity, creativity, and self-authorship
Module 5: The Return — integration, values, and what comes next

services.tagline: Gentle strategy for creators in the messy middle.
services.description:
Gentle strategy for creators in the messy middle — when you know something powerful is forming but need clarity on the next step.
You'll leave with:
- Recorded session for reference
- Written summary of recommendations
- One clear next step

Best for:
Creators in the messy middle who need a thinking partner, not a course.

services.name: WhollyInspired Publishing Package
services.description: The complete Midnight Magnolia publishing experience — two 90-minute sessions held at whatever pace your nervous system can meet. Together we'll move through manuscript development, KDP setup, cover direction, distribution strategy, and a personalized publishing plan built around your life and your timeline, not someone else's launch calendar. This is for the author who is ready to bring their whole story into the world — with support that honors the weight of what they're carrying and the power of what they've written.

services.name: Free 15-Minute Publishing Consultation
services.description: Before you commit, let's connect. This free 15-minute call is an unhurried conversation to hear where you are in your writing journey, what kind of support would serve you best, and whether working together is the right fit. No pressure. No pitch. Just a quiet, honest conversation between two people who take words seriously. Book your call and bring whatever questions are sitting with you.

services.name: Manuscript Development
services.description: Your story has always been worth telling. This 90-minute 1:1 session is where we begin. We'll clarify your vision, excavate your voice, and map a clear path from the messy middle of your manuscript to a finished work you're proud to put your name on. Healing-centered pacing throughout — no rush, no pressure, no performance. Just honest, skilled guidance for the author who's ready to go deeper.

services.name: VIP Half-Day Intensive
services.tagline: Real-time collaboration / body-doubling support for creators who move best with focused partnership.
services.description:
Real-time collaboration and body-doubling support for creators who move best with focused partnership.
Duration: 3 hours (with breaks)

Description:
For creators who want to get a significant piece of work done  *with* someone, not just advised by someone. We'll spend a focused half-day together—building your Notion system, refining your website copy, mapping your content strategy, or whatever you need most.

You'll leave with:
- Completed deliverable (not just a plan)
- Recorded session
- 1 week of follow-up support

Best for:
Those who do better with body-doubling and real-time collaboration.

Investment: $497

Availability: 2 spots per month

services.name: Notion Sanctuary Setup
services.tagline: One calm digital workspace designed specifically for you.
services.description:
One calm digital workspace designed specifically for your creative process, ideas, and projects.

You'll leave with:
- A custom Notion dashboard designed for neurodivergent-friendly workflow
- Task management that doesn't overwhelm
- Content planning system (if applicable)
- 2 weeks of async support for questions

services.name: KDP Self-Publishing Setup
services.description: You wrote the book. Now let's get it into the world. This 60-minute guided session walks you through everything Amazon KDP requires — formatting, metadata, cover specifications, category selection, and pricing strategy — without the overwhelm or the jargon. You'll leave with your book live or a clear, confident roadmap to launch day. This is the session that turns a file on your desktop into a book people can hold.

services.name: Book + Journal Bundle Package
services.description: The most powerful healing products don't stand alone — they travel together. This 2-hour session is designed for authors building both a book and a companion shadow work or healing journal. We'll develop both concepts in tandem: voice, structure, layout direction, and a publishing roadmap that treats them as the ecosystem they are. If you're building a transformational product suite rooted in healing, this is where that begins.

services.name: Brand Voice Clarity Session
services.tagline: Find the language that truly sounds like you.
services.description:
Find the language that truly sounds like you. Together we'll shape your story, message, and creative voice.

You'll leave with:
- A written brand voice guide (tone, do's and don'ts, sample phrases)
- 3-5 taglines or positioning statements
- Clarity on your core message
